title: CausalRM: Causal-Theoretic Reward Modeling for RLHF from Observational User Feedbacks

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating observational feedback with distribution shifts by assigning propensity scores based on ground-truth preferences (users preferentially providing feedback on strong opinions), and evaluating the reward model's ability to recover true preferences using Inverse Propensity Scoring (IPS) and Doubly Robust (DR) estimators.
